utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven't heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can ask around while I'm out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be great, Ira. If you hear anything, just let me know and I’ll keep my schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s to help cover the cost of fixing the community center roof and a few broken lights.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — roof and lights. How do I chip in?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear before we say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on, but you’re checking the details first? Just let me know the final time and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to what needs doing and I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. I’ve got a little list of supplies and fixes—once I sort it out, I’ll bring it by your place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect—just drop it by when you’re ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for it. I’ll try to remember it this time, honest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the details for the repair drive before I do anything?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy on the details, but I know it’s for collecting supplies and funds for the neighborhood fixes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I’ll wait for the full details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — it’s going well so far, and we’ve got a decent little pile started. Glad you’re here; we could use another hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks — I’ll keep repeating it at the repair drive so everyone stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or handle?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your drill and maybe a few screwdrivers? I’ll handle the heavier stuff and set out the workbench.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my drill and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is happening and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check which street it’s on and tell you as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard a few folks are already dropping things off for the repair drive—it’s looking pretty promising.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great news! I’m going to pass the word around and make sure more folks know they can drop things off anytime.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn—every little bit helps, and folks can bring things by whenever it’s convenient.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring anything for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Maybe just some gloves and tape, if you have them. Thanks, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — I’ll bring gloves and tape.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and repeat the plan to the others.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll pass that along if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m organizing the repair drive list now, so if you know any neighbors who need a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll think on it and let you know if anyone comes to mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list open, so just message me whenever someone comes to mind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are pitching in more than expected. If you want, I can tell you what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, please do — a clear list would help me know where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure — they still need a few volunteers for setup, some donated tools, and a couple extra snacks for the crew. I can share the exact list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great — I’m here now, so point me to the next thing that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — let’s start with the repair drive list, and I’ll keep repeating the plan as we go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — what’s first on the list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I still need someone to help sort the donations and load the boxes, if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can do that. I’ll help sort the donations and load the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive needing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mostly small appliance parts and a few tools, like screwdrivers and tape. I can help keep a running list of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for those. Send me the list if anything specific comes up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive. What do you want people to know first?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — first, let people know it’s for fixing everyday items, not throwing them away. I’m checking the exact date and location before I share more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll keep it focused on repairing everyday items. Send me the date and location when you have them, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’ve moved it to Saturday morning at the community hall, and I’m still coordinating a few volunteers. I can send you the latest details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, please send me the latest details — I’ll try to keep up this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — if you spot anyone who needs a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll pass it along if I hear anyone’s looking for help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — can you pick up the extra tape and a box of screws? That would really help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can pick up the extra tape and a box of screws. I’ll let you know once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to check the timing and make sure we’ve got the right supplies lined up first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds fair—when can you check the timing, and what supplies do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can check the timing this evening, and I’ll make a quick list of the supplies we’re missing once I know the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in—count me as the first to spread the word about the repair drive. When and where are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — we’re meeting Saturday at the community shed by the park at 10 a.m. I’ll bring the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll start telling folks right away and be there Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community shed by the park.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Faye — I’m still pulling the details together, but I’d love your help coordinating it around school hours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—send me the timing once you have it, and I’ll work it around drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone updated. If you’ve got any priority fixes, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll pass along anything I hear. I mostly get news second-hand, so I may be a bit behind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Nell — second-hand news still helps a lot. Just send me whatever comes up, and I’ll keep the list moving.
